canonical_project: Project Marvel Bessemer data center campus
owner: QTS Data Centers; Logistic Land Investment LLC / TPA Group as developer/land vehicle

location.site_context: Project Marvel site in the Bessemer area, near Rock Mountain Lake Road and the planned Northern Beltline corridor

history.previous: Logistic Land Investment LLC / TPA Group
history.updated: QTS Data Centers; Logistic Land Investment LLC / TPA Group as developer/land vehicle
history.reason: QTS published an official Bessemer data center page and gave local media a statement that it is pursuing plans for a proposed campus on the Project Marvel site.
Bessemer City Council rezoning approvals cover the original site and the 914-acre expansion, but no source verified site work, construction, energization, or live capacity.
QTS official Bessemer page shows a July 14, 2026 modification date and confirms the project remains in development.

contradictions: Acreage is reported at about 700 acres / 677 acres for the original plan, plus 914 additional acres / about 900 acres, yielding an updated roughly 1,600-acre campus. Sources align directionally but use rounded figures.

QTS official materials confirm a Bessemer facility in development but do not publish the Project Marvel name or the 1.2 GW capacity; capacity remains supported by developer presentation/local reporting and DCD, not by QTS's site page.
No source found in this refresh confirms building permits, site clearing, construction start, utility contract execution, energization, or live service.
